task: Phase 2 / Task 5 - Feature Engineering & Feature Selection

targets.target_laptime: Lap time in seconds - primary regression target (Task 6).
targets.target_pit_next_lap: 1 if the driver pits at the end of this lap - classification.
targets.target_laptime_fuel_corrected: Lap time with the fuel-burn trend (-0.0613 s/lap) removed, isolating tyre degradation.

feature_provenance.compound_medium: Compound contrast vs the HARD reference level.
feature_provenance.compound_soft: Compound contrast vs the HARD reference level.
feature_provenance.field_median_lag1: Field median lap time on the previous lap - the ambient pace level (absorbs track evolution, safety cars, fuel effects common to everyone).
feature_provenance.field_pace_trend: Change in field median between the last two laps - is the track speeding up or slowing?
feature_provenance.form_vs_baseline: Last lap's gap relative to the driver's own baseline: are they gaining or losing form?
feature_provenance.gap_expanding: Running mean gap over all previous laps - the driver's baseline competitiveness.
feature_provenance.gap_roll3_mean: Mean gap to the field over the previous 3 laps - short-run pace.
feature_provenance.gap_roll3_std: Volatility of that gap - unstable laps often precede a tyre cliff or traffic.
feature_provenance.is_fresh_tyre: Whether the set was new when fitted (scrubbed sets behave differently).
feature_provenance.stint_number: Which stint of the race this is - proxies for race phase and strategy state.
feature_provenance.track_status: Track status flag - constant in this session; retained so the NZV filter can remove it.
feature_provenance.tracktemp_dev_x_tyrelife: Interaction: degradation accelerates on a hotter-than-average surface. Track temp is mean-centred so this is not a rescaled tyre_life.
feature_provenance.tyre_life: Laps completed on the current tyre set - the primary degradation driver.
feature_provenance.tyrelife_x_medium: Interaction: MEDIUM degradation slope relative to the HARD baseline.
feature_provenance.tyrelife_x_soft: Interaction: lets the model learn SOFT's steeper degradation slope vs HARD.

preprocessing_contract.scaling: NOT applied here. Fit the scaler inside each CV fold to avoid leakage.
preprocessing_contract.validation: Expanding-window lap-forward split; keep whole laps in one fold. Do not use random K-fold - this is a time-ordered panel.

selection_funnel.4_importance_and_stability: ranked by mutual information + tree importance + L1 coefficient; K*=45 chosen within 2% of best CV MAE

excluded_as_leakage.reason: Sector times sum exactly to LapTime; speed traps and IsPersonalBest are only knowable during or after the lap being predicted.

validation_scores.caveat: 48 pit event(s) observed across 21 distinct laps (the busiest lap accounts for 12% of all pits) - a reasonably realistic spread of strategic pit timing. This remains a single session, though, and results should not be generalised beyond it.
